positions.title: Principal Engineering Technologist
positions.description:
•	A main member of Microsoft Azure platform team, focus on new product introduction (NPI) from proof of concept (POC), implementation, validation, documentation to providing knowledge transfer and demo of Azure products to different Dell Azure engineering teams and product management teams
•	Perform end to end validation for Dell APEX Cloud Platform with Microsoft Azure 2407/2408 baseline release for Hub and HCI (Hyperconverged Infrastructure)
•	In charge of creating engineering change order (ECO) request to publish Dell Azure related deliverable packages on Dell support page
•	Produce and deliver engineering knowledge transfer content for 15G and 16G Dell PowerEdge servers with PowerFlex storage to professional service teams and address any questions and concerns from various functional team and Azure cloud customers
•	Find and report any Azure software bugs to Microsoft core team

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	A leading member of L3 escalation team to assist customer support L1 and L2 team and provide guidance and suggestion to resolve any complex EHC (Enterprise Hybrid Cloud) issues
•	Collaborate with various engineering teams to provide workaround/hotfix/patch to resolve customer issues and meet the customer's expectation
•	Provide technical guidance and recommendations to 50+ EHC customers on upgrades for VxBlock and VxRail and transitions to VMwre Cloud Foundation on VxRail
•	Provide technical assistance during business hours and oncall for EHC customers who perform disaster recovery (DR) failover and failback off business hours and weekends
•	Deep dive into each solution VMware components and provide any technical information to resolve VMware related issues
•	Member of RPQ (Request for Product Qualification) committee to review, validate, accept/reject RPQ request  
•	Manage Atlassian migration operation for engineering organization, host weekly progress meeting with IT migration team and work with wider teams for tracking test cases in Jira, and Zephyr replacement and Bamboo to Jenkins migration
•	Successfully completed L3 technical support for EHC solution from beginning to end of life (EOL) (8+ years)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Work as a key member of Elab team and perform EMC enterprise hybrid cloud solution proof of concept (POC) validation 
•	Develop a test plan, test schedule based on Agile Scrum model and engineering specification
•	Develop framework and test suites based on solution requirements document of hybrid cloud solution
•	Reviewing of security of the cloud and perform interoperability and scale out and infrastructure resiliency and fault injection on hybrid cloud solution
•	Recipient of EMC excellence silver award on dedicated project contribution
•	Attend core infrastructure meetings to stay on top of developments and assist in administrative tasks to support the cloud platforms and the Core infrastructure
•	Build a test bed for performing sanity tests during cloud solution POC testing
•	Training China and Ireland teams on EMC products and provide technical support to troubleshoot any new EMC products issues
•	A key contact for Level 3 global customer support team on various EMC plug-in products

positions.title: Software Developer 3
positions.description:
•	Develop test plan and test matrix on Exadata and Exalogic systems
•	Work closely with project manager discuss project deadlines and reprioritize the goals for the current release.
•	Highly self-motivated and disciplined professional with sharp, intelligent mind when digging through data
•	Execute on Exadata Perform stress and load testing (RDS, OAST, ORION, UPERF, IOmeter) on Exadata systems
•	Perform destructive test and design verification on appliance storage
•	Communicate with core developers to diagnosed and troubleshoot complex Oracle Exalogic systems
•	Provide supports and troubleshoot any cloud issues on Exalogic systems by develop and executing shell scripts
•	Deploy and execute Oracle Middleware such as Weblogic servers on Exalogic systems
•	Execute J2EE Java application via SDP protocol and troubleshoot execution issues with automation java application engineers

positions.title: Senior QA Engineer/Test Lead
positions.description:
• Project Lead qualification of X64 based servers and workstations

• Responsible for all planning and scheduling for qualification activities

• Host meetings to discuss project deadlines and reprioritize the goals for the current release.

• Influence the decisions to include project concerning code changes and bug fixes in

release cycles

• Interface with other development groups and assist in reviewing/evaluating/
adopting automation technologies or procedures

• Develop test plans and execute all hardware and software qualification activities

• Provide technical interface for external test and primary interface between service
providers, Sun engineering, and customers for supported X64 platforms

• Configure and testing various platforms including workstation and blades using
automated in-house developed tools

• Configure Cisco switches using TCP/IP protocol

• Execute and submit Red hat, Microsoft Windows Server 2008 R2 hardware
certification

• Testing VMware, Windows Hyper-V visualization on various platforms

• Configure and perform stress on various Sun Microsystem ZFS NAS storage
appliance

• Generate perl, korn, bash, csh shell scripts to testing various platform’s Service
Processor and program fru information via IPMI tools

• Work actively with developers to help configure and debug development issues

educations.fieldOfStudy: Major in Bioengineering and Biomedical Engineering, Minor in Computer Science
